findings.summary: At 4 years for self-employed, the fund shows no number, only empty boxes and a note. The only big number belongs to a different account, so it can be mistaken for the answer.
The bar labels sit below the bars, a scroll away from the numbers, and the main white bar has no label next to its number.
The 'החזר המס הוסיף' label isn't explained, so it's unclear why money would come back.
The first field is labelled 'הכנסה חייבת', which the reader doesn't understand. This could lead to entering the wrong number.
The line about 13,205 ₪ a year below the chart appears without context.
